instruction:
Weight-Selective Bevel `/home/user/Desktop/scene.blend` contains a single mesh object `Block` (a cube of dimensions 2x2x2 centred on the origin). Launch Blender by running `blender` from a terminal. For the steps below, use `/opt/blender/blender` for Blender command-line or background runs when working on `scene.blend`.

The mesh carries an edge-domain float attribute `bevel_weight_edge`. Use that attribute to bevel only the edges whose weight is greater than 0.5, then apply the modifier so no modifier remains. Save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.blend`. ## Bevel parameters - Width (offset-mode distance): 0.10 BU. - Segments: 2. - Profile shape: 0.5 (circular arc). - Limited so only weighted edges are affected. ## Requirements 1. Output scene contains exactly one mesh object, named `Block`, at world origin. 2. `Block`'s modifier stack is empty. 3. `Block`'s mesh is closed-manifold (every edge shared by exactly two faces). 4. Overall bounding box is unchanged (x,y,z each still span +-1 within tol 5e-3). 5. The beveled edges are the ones indicated by `bevel_weight_edge`.
